description: Task-progress historical-family inventory (plan §3.10). Mechanical anchors (declaration digest, field universe) are regenerated by scripts/generateTaskProgressHistory.mjs --generate; family definitions are human-authored and preserved. verify:task-progress-history fails on a stale declaration digest, a family missing a rule for any persisted field, and anything other than exactly one legacy-default family.

families.description: The single supported pre-versioning family: every task-progress.json shape emitted by released Ensemble builds up to now. No ensembleProgressVersion field exists in the persisted shape yet; the permissive reader (src/utils/taskProgressUtils.ts readTaskProgress) is the current de-facto normalizer for this family, and the field-by-field rules below are what the strict V1 decoder (src/services/taskProgressDecoderV1.ts) accepts as legacy input. Fields added over time (archivedFrom, pinnedAt, publishScopePath, fallbackModelId, reviewScoreHistory, escalation, scheduledRun/scheduledResumeTime) were all added as OPTIONAL properties, so older files that simply omit them remain members of this same family — absence of an optional field is compatible input, not a distinct family. The family also includes the historical { schemaVersion, data } envelope wrapper (unwrapped today by src/state/migratePersistedState.ts): the strict decoder accepts that wrapper for this family only — exactly those two keys, numeric schemaVersion, object payload — and flattens it on migration; an envelope whose payload carries ensembleProgressVersion is recovery.
families.versionSelector: ensembleProgressVersion property ABSENT (strict selection: absent + this family's field rules all satisfied → supported legacy input; absent + any rule violated → recovery; any present ensembleProgressVersion other than exact integer 1 → recovery, per plan §3.10).
families.evidence: src/types/taskProgress.ts TaskProgress declaration (digest above); permissive normalization behavior in src/utils/taskProgressUtils.ts (readTaskProgress) and src/state/migratePersistedState.ts (envelope unwrap); release tag v0.43.0^{} = d19cd0ec5e541b138f21c847e78a9a320b5c0fda as the released code-diff reference (plan Phase 0); every field's historicalFamilyRule row in task-progress-fields-v1.json; strict acceptance pinned by src/test/taskProgressDecoderV1.test.ts + test-fixtures/task-progress/legacy/**.

fieldRules.taskFolder: Required string; must equal the discovered task folder name.
fieldRules.displayName: Optional string; absence means the generated default label is in use.
fieldRules.nameIsDefault: Optional exact boolean; no coercion from truthy values.
fieldRules.currentStage: Required; one valid canonical stage (historical aliases resolve through the stage canonicalization the permissive reader applies today).
fieldRules.status: Optional TaskStatus; absence means active (backward compat per the declaration's doc comment).
fieldRules.completedAt: Optional ISO string preserved as inert historical metadata with any status — completion is inferred solely from status, never from this field (archiveTask/resumeArchivedTask persist archived/active documents that keep it).
fieldRules.archivedFrom: Optional TaskStatus recorded at archive time; later additions omit-compatible (older files simply lack it).
fieldRules.pinnedAt: Optional ISO string present only while pinned; omit-compatible.
fieldRules.completedStages: Optional array of known unique stages; the only production writer (markTaskDone.ts) records just ["publish"], so the strict decoder canonicalizes by backfilling to the prefix through the highest recorded stage (plan §3.11); duplicates after canonicalization and unknown stages are recovery.
fieldRules.preImageDescription: Optional bounded string; preserve or omit per this family.
fieldRules.ownership: Optional persisted project/meta-root binding; when absent, resolve only from one unambiguous current binding or enter recovery (plan §3.11). Never a lease.
fieldRules.createdAt: Required ISO string; validate and preserve.
fieldRules.updatedAt: Required ISO string; validate/preserve on format-only migration.
fieldRules.implReviewFiles: Optional bounded task-local review references; absence maps only where this family permits (older files lack it).
fieldRules.lintPayload: Optional; validate/preserve without granting runtime ownership (consumed then cleared by transitions, plan §3.11).
fieldRules.scheduledRun: Optional; valid only with its companion fields — inconsistent scheduledRun/scheduledResumeTime combinations are recovery.
fieldRules.scheduledResumeTime: Optional; validated together with scheduledRun; no coercion.
fieldRules.fallbackActive: Optional per-stage map ONLY (Partial<Record<TaskStage, boolean>>); scalar boolean input is invalid in every supported family (plan §3.11 — 'reject scalar booleans').
fieldRules.fallbackModelId: Optional per-stage map of non-empty model-id strings with canonical stage keys only (matches the declared Partial<Record<TaskStage, string>> shape); omit-compatible.
fieldRules.reviewAttemptId: Optional string; valid only as inert historical state (cleared by transitions, plan §3.11).
fieldRules.reviewScoreHistory: Optional bounded array of review score entries; omit-compatible.
fieldRules.reviewRejections: Never emitted by this family's writers (introduced by ensemble-v1, workflow-resilience 2d); absence is the only legacy shape. If present it is validated exactly like V1 input.

families.description: The strict V1 shape (plan §3.10), emitted only by the strict writer (src/services/taskProgressWriterV1.ts) after splice-based migration or fresh creation: a flat object carrying ensembleProgressVersion: 1 as its first property, canonical stage/status values only (no legacy aliases, no synthetic 'completed' stage, no envelope wrapper), unknown ensemble* fields failing closed into recovery, and opaque non-product properties preserved byte-identically and in order.
families.versionSelector: ensembleProgressVersion === exact integer 1 (any other present value → recovery; the property inside a { schemaVersion, data } envelope → recovery, per plan §3.10).
families.evidence: src/services/taskProgressDecoderV1.ts (strict selector/decoder), src/services/taskProgressWriterV1.ts (canonical emitter/migrator), src/test/taskProgressDecoderV1.test.ts, src/test/taskProgressWriterV1.test.ts, test-fixtures/task-progress/v1/** and recovery/**.

fieldRules.taskFolder: Required bounded non-empty string; must equal the discovered folder when the caller provides it.
fieldRules.currentStage: Required canonical stage only; legacy aliases and the synthetic 'completed' stage are recovery in this family.
fieldRules.status: Optional canonical TaskStatus only (absence materializes active); legacy finished/done aliases are recovery in this family.
fieldRules.completedAt: Optional ISO timestamp preserved as inert history regardless of status (completion is inferred solely from status; archive/resume flows keep it on non-completed documents).
fieldRules.completedStages: Optional array of unique canonical stages; canonicalized to the contiguous STAGE_ORDER prefix through the highest recorded stage (gapped terminal ticks backfill); duplicates and unknown stages are recovery.
fieldRules.ownership: Optional exact-shape binding (non-empty metaRoot/projectRoot, ISO boundAt, optional non-empty workspaceRoot, optional state enum); unknown nested keys are recovery. Never a lease.
fieldRules.implReviewFiles: Optional bounded array (≤4096) of bounded non-empty strings; non-string entries are recovery.
fieldRules.lintPayload: Optional exact shape (ISO runAt, boolean passed, bounded optional summary/issueCount/failedChecks); unknown nested keys are recovery.
fieldRules.scheduledRun: Optional exact shape (ISO runAt, canonical stage, optional bounded leaseOwner, optional ISO leaseUntil); unknown nested keys are recovery.
fieldRules.scheduledResumeTime: Optional ISO timestamp; presence together with scheduledRun is conflicting-alias recovery.
fieldRules.fallbackActive: Optional per-stage boolean map only (decodeFallbackStateV1); scalars and unknown stage keys are recovery.
fieldRules.fallbackModelId: Optional per-stage map of bounded non-empty model-id strings with canonical stage keys only.
fieldRules.reviewScoreHistory: Optional bounded exact-shape array (≤ MAX_REVIEW_SCORE_HISTORY); unknown entry keys are recovery.
fieldRules.reviewRejections: Optional bounded exact-shape array (≤ MAX_REVIEW_REJECTIONS: canonical stage, bounded non-empty attemptId, ISO at, bounded non-empty reason); unknown entry keys are recovery.
fieldRules.escalation: Optional exact shape (canonical stage, recognized kind, bounded reason, ISO at, optional boolean secondOpinionAttempted); unknown nested keys are recovery.
